item.title: Passion - Released into Early Access
item.description: The J-RPG Passion has been released into Early Access: Passion A story-driven 16-bit-style JRPG blending noir mystery, comedy, horror, and psychedelic weirdness. Investigate a strange town, explore dangerous dungeons, and master tactical ATB-inspired combat where timing, status effects, and preparation matter....

item.title: Queen's Domain - Review @ RPS
item.description: Rock Paper Shotgun reviewed Queen's Domain: Queen's Domain is a brilliant King's Field-alike RPG that forces you to walk so you can learn to fly I would also have accepted "Prince's Place" or "Baron's Turf" FromSoftware's elderly King's Field games aren't really celebrated for their feeling of agility....
